_about: Build 2026-11-17a (test 56's fixes and its art corrections, on top of 2026-11-16b: the first-person camera found as the game eases it, the bike kept near the camera at a handover; the worn bike drawn again in third person after your body, the eye in front of the neck, the first-person arms hidden with the look key; the weapon rules kept across a menu, rifles never drawn while riding, a quick swap judged again, the spikes from the hands; the field kit's bike held, zoomed and turned to each slot, the kit set out where you stand when its spot has no room; the take-off a tad quicker, a stop's down-shifts one gear at a time; the Brotherhood of Steel, Minutemen, Nuka-Cola and Red Rocket plates redrawn, the Gunners skull on a green flag patch, the Brotherhood of Steel tank badge in colour, the Enclave helmet's chrome ground, Saddle tan less yellow), packaged on 2026-11-10a's package as the asset base with six overlays laid over it in this order (OVERLAY=<1>:<2>:<3>:<4>:<5>:<6>, the later winning): 2026-11-16a's four, unchanged (/opt/cmb/assets15b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/a/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/c/Data), then the badges unit's (/opt/cmb/assets17a/badges/Data: badges_d/_n/_s.dds by bike_art.py --badges and look_badges.py, seat_p.dds by look_seat.py; it replaces 16a's b and c files of those names) and the plates unit's (/opt/cmb/assets17a/plates/Data: plates_d/_n/_s.dds and plate_p.dds by bike_art.py --plates and look_plates.py; it replaces 16a's b files of those names). No two of the new overlays' files overlap. Keys starting with _ are comments. What differs from the 2026-11-16b package, in two kinds: (1) the commit's own shipped files, checked against the commit by the tracked-files check and never listed in vs_previous (verify_zips.py --list-changes compares only the assets and the compiled scripts): Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.ini, Data/Scripts/Source/User/CMB_ControllerScript.psc, and Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.dll once the build's DLL is committed (the package takes the DLL from the commit, so tools/f4se-slope/build.sh's DLL has to be committed first; git diff --stat ddf7b1e <the build's commit> -- Data lists them); the ESP and the MCM folder are 2026-11-16b's byte for byte; (2) the compiled scripts and assets, below (vs_previous): the eight textures and CMB_ControllerScript.pex.
_previous: The 2026-11-16b package: the verifier's --previous (/opt/cmb/out/2026-11-16b/CommonwealthMotorbike_2026-11-16b). The asset base is 2026-11-10a's Data (assets.sha256), with 2026-11-16a's four overlays and this build's two.

esp._records: The ESP is 2026-11-16b's byte for byte (git diff ddf7b1e <the build's commit> -- Data/CommonwealthMotorbike.esp is empty; tools/build.sh regenerates it unchanged, and --look-build 2026-11-08a and 2026-11-07a still give 2026-11-15b's and fdb5b3a's): espcmp.py 2026-11-16b's ESP against this one: 'TES4: same', 'added 0', 'removed 0', 'changed 0'. The new behaviours need no form: the controller's new switches are bits of the existing CMB_RoomOptions (2048, 4096) and CMB_LookOptions (131072), the kit's ask is the room ask's existing globals with a new kind (4).
esp._edids: No record is new or changed: 2026-11-16b's list, as it was (the three Tune globals 2026-11-16b changed first, then 2026-11-16a's). An older plugin has the same names; the bytes are held by the tracked-files check (the package's ESP is the commit's, byte for byte).

_counts: 2026-11-16b's: no file added or removed (the eight textures are replaced in place, the same sizes).
_vs_previous: What verify_zips.py --list-changes compares: the assets (the files under Data/Meshes/CMB, Textures/CMB, Materials/CMB, Sound/FX/CMB and the riding clips' folder) and the compiled scripts (Data/Scripts/*.pex, by their code, not their headers) against the 2026-11-16b package. Eight textures differ, each the same size as 2026-11-16b's, with its sha256 in this package (the files in the two overlays; the units' notes list the same): the badge atlas (badges_d/_n/_s.dds: the Gunners skull on a green flag patch, the Brotherhood of Steel colour emblem, the Enclave helmet's chrome ground; 2026-11-16b's 558821439c..., c8d04936dd..., caf559c35b...), the seat palette (seat_p.dds: Saddle tan a76239; 2026-11-16b's a0612f9959...), the plate atlas (plates_d/_n/_s.dds: the four redrawn designs; 2026-11-16b's e0ada58182..., 66f0430260..., a766f90320...) and the plate palette (plate_p.dds: gold at U 49, Red Rocket's own row yellow; 2026-11-16b's 245eff314c..., shipped since 2026-11-08a). Every material, mesh, sound and clip is 2026-11-16b's, and so are plate_text_d/_n/_s.dds and plate_text_p.dds. One compiled script differs, CMB_ControllerScript (its source changed: GunJudgeWait's second look, the message for a rifle kept holstered, the field kit's spot asked about), null accepting its bytes (its header carries the packaged commit's time); CMB_LookF4SE and the other ten keep their code under a new header. The commit's own files that change (CMB_Slope.dll and CMB_Slope.ini, the .psc: _about) are not in this block.
